title: Post-epic LOW batch: deep-review + per-ticket-review cosmetic/test-gap follow-ups (TASK-165..174 drive)
description:
Disposition batch for the LOW findings accumulated across the 2026-07-18 intake+kb-graph epic drive (per-ticket reviews) and the epic-gate deep-review (0 HIGH / 3 MEDIUM / 12 LOW — MEDIUMs fixed pre-release in the deep-review fix commit). None are release-blocking; all confirmed real by adversarial verification. Work through as a single cleanup pass (tests-after; skip any item that has become stale):

From the deep-review (unique):
1. backlog-seeder buildPlanTemplate: whitespace-only problem_statement bypasses the '(none captured at intake)' placeholder (trimmed vs untrimmed guard inconsistency, line ~324 vs ~336). [found twice — one fix]
2. bin/init.js buildScopeOverlapWarning echoes normalized lowercase tokens, not the user's original casing.
3. bin/init.js findScopeOverlap computed twice per warning emission (guard + builder both call it).
4. kb_graph_query surfaces unconstrained ref/label strings agents are told to auto-follow — constrain GRAPH_SCHEMA ref to a repo-relative path shape (reject absolute, .., URL schemes) or filter in sortNodesById (read-steering hardening; LOW under the repo-local trust model).
5. kb-graph-query spec: type post-filter composed with relation/direction ({id, relation, type}) documented but untested.
6. graph-sync recordNode's failed-canonical shape { source:'failed', error } has no direct unit lock.
7. bin/init.js buildUnderspecifiedWarning single-label 'is' verb branch unreachable + untested.
8. backlog-seeder normalizeDefinitionList comma-string branch untested.
9. mcp-server recordTaskGraphNode 'skipped' branch + label fallback (task?.title ?? key) untested.
10. scripts/backfill-graph-task-nodes.mjs has no test incl. its idempotency claim.
11. intake-underspecified-warn.spec.js redundant spec: 'never_hard_blocks...' is an assertion-subset of 'warns_and_still_proceeds...' (fold or drop; also two answers-mode specs could merge).

From per-ticket reviews (still open after the epic):
12. TASK-165 rev: mintTicket docblock 'body MUST contain the tag substring' invariant contradicts the plan tag's body — scope the invariant to common/use-case tags.
13. TASK-169 rev: graph-freshness sensor silently skips a done ticket with a malformed key — add a malformed-key bucket so it fails closed.
14. TASK-171 rev: canonical-mirror status invisible in close_task's graph_node field when a brain is present (latent until brain wired).
15. TASK-172 rev: kb_graph_query rejection error carries code in message but E_KB_NOT_FOUND convention lacks it — align makeErr convention repo-wide (or accept divergence deliberately).
acceptance_criteria: Each numbered item is either fixed with a minimal lock (where a spec gap) or explicitly waived with a one-line rationale in the closing comment — no silent drops.
Existing suites stay green; dist rebuilt + committed if bundled source changes; dist-parity green.
New-test budget respected: locks only for real gaps; the redundant-spec items (11) REMOVE tests rather than add.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Item 16 (from rev of the deep-review fix commit d101885, LOW): orchestrator-routing SKILL.md:978-984 (both parity copies) still says an id query "resolves against the canonical wisearcher brain graph first when the brain is wired in" — over-promises vs the reconciled tool description (canonical path needs brain AND canonicalId; the tool cannot accept canonicalId today). Not a direct contradiction (operational guidance unaffected) but repeats the imprecision MEDIUM-1 fixed in the tool. Fix wording to "when a brain and canonical id are wired in" — or fold into whichever follow-up plumbs canonicalId through kb_graph_query.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED. Tier `tests-after`; single commit `80edf15` (17 files, 528+/103-).

**PROCESS DEVIATION — read this before trusting the close.** This ticket closed WITHOUT an independent fresh-context Reviewer pass, on explicit human direction (2026-08-02: "dont over review we want to do a general review after"). The per-ticket reviewer is normally the load-bearing quality gate here; for this ticket the only verification is the Developer's own self-report plus the Orchestrator's independent full-suite run. **This diff is unvetted by an independent reviewer and should be treated as such by the deferred general review.**

**AC1 — no silent drops: all 16 items dispositioned.** 14 fixed, 2 waived with rationale:

FIXED: (1) backlog-seeder whitespace-only `problem_statement` now trims before the placeholder guard; (2) `buildScopeOverlapWarning` echoes the user's ORIGINAL casing via a new `computeScopeOverlapConflicts` tracking `{normalized, original}`; (3) that same helper computed once and passed to the builder, killing the double computation; (4) read-side `safeRef()`/`UNSAFE_REF_RE` in `sortNodesById` nulls absolute paths, `..` traversal and URL schemes — write-side `GRAPH_SCHEMA` deliberately untouched as a genuine trust-boundary change out of scope; (5) `{id, relation, type}` composition now tested; (6) `recordNode` failed-canonical shape locked; (7) singular-verb branch tested; (8) `normalizeDefinitionList` comma-string branch tested; (9) `recordTaskGraphNode` exported (both branches were unreachable through the `close_task` tool because the schema's key pattern is a strict subset of `taskKeyToNodeId`'s) and directly tested; (10) `backfill-graph-task-nodes.mjs` refactored to an injectable `main({repoRoot})` with a new e2e spec covering the idempotency claim; (11) redundant specs REMOVED — net -1 test in that file even after item 7's addition; (12) `mintTicket` docblock invariant scoped to common/use-case tags; (13) graph-freshness now folds a malformed-key done ticket into `missing` (fails CLOSED) instead of silently skipping, and the backfill script throws loudly rather than calling `addNode` with `id: null`; (16) orchestrator-routing SKILL.md canonical-first wording corrected in BOTH parity copies, verified byte-identical.

WAIVED: (14) canonical-mirror status in `close_task`'s `graph_node` — no production call site wires a real brain (always `null`), and surfacing canonical status is a breaking shape change to a documented string contract; belongs in its own ticket once a brain is actually wired. (15) `makeErr` message-format divergence — realigning across 7+ call sites risks breaking message-substring assertions elsewhere for a cosmetic LOW; divergence accepted deliberately.

**AC2 — suites green, dist fresh.** Developer gate: `test:changed` 14 files/149 passed; `npm test` 76 files/1027 passed, 2 skipped; `test:all` after `build:plugin` 169 files/1944 passed. `dist/init.cjs` + `dist/mcp-server.cjs` rebuilt and committed; `dist/pack-ctl.cjs` came out byte-identical and was correctly left alone per the concurrent-work constraint. Orchestrator re-ran `test:all` independently on the post-merge tree: **169 files / 1944 passed, 4 skipped, dist-parity green.**

**AC3 — new-test budget.** Locks added only for real gaps; item 11 removed tests as required. Developer reports red-green planting (revert → confirm red → restore) for the 8 items with genuine behavior changes: 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 13. Items 3, 7, 8, 11, 12, 16 are refactors/doc fixes/dead-branch coverage where the fix IS the test, with no toggleable src behavior. **This red-green claim is self-reported and was not independently reproduced** — see the process deviation above.

**No UAT run.** Tier is `tests-after` and most items are internal, but items 2 (user-visible warning casing) and 16 (skill doc wording) are human-observable; neither was UAT-verified. Worth eyeballing during the general review.

**Affected e2e specs for the general review to re-run:** `intake-scope-overlap-warn`, `intake-underspecified-warn`, `backlog-seeder-plan-ticket`, `kb-graph-query`, `mcp-close-task`, `backfill-graph-task-nodes` (new), plus fast-tier `graph-freshness` and `graph-sync`.
